Start from an existing TEI edition

The new project includes copies of the TEI, alignments, CSS, Ctrl+E configuration and translations. The default XSLT stays in the application; a custom XSLT is copied into the project. Choose an empty folder.

Varians will automatically create a minimal TEI file in xml/edition.xml. Add at least one witness and explicitly choose “No images for now” if you are beginning the transcription without a facsimile. ALTO and synchronization can be added later. In automatic schema mode, the new TEI references TEI All through xml-model. Choose an empty folder.

Each XML file is automatically recognized as ALTO or PAGE. PAGE polygons and ALTO rectangles are retained. File order is used to match pages when names do not match.
